title: Nullable Types and Pattern Matching
summary: null and nullable reference types, the warnings that catch null bugs, the operators ?. ?? and ??=, nullable value types like int?, tuples, and pattern matching with is, switch expressions, type, relational, logical, property and list patterns.

cards.q: What does name?.Length ?? 0 give when name is null?
cards.a:
0

`?.` gives null instead of throwing, and `??` replaces that null with 0.

cards.q: Why does the order of switch arms matter?
cards.a:
Arms are tried from the top, and the first one that matches wins

Only the first matching arm runs, so a broad arm (like `_`) above a narrower one hides it. The compiler reports an arm that can never be reached.
